## **About Me**



Hi, welcome to my website! 


I am a PhD  candidate in Economics at the  University of Oklahoma. 

I work on applied micro issues focusing on environment and ecology, agricultural economics, international trade, development, and public economics.


In my free time, I like to read, camp, or make travel plans with my family. 


## Research Interests

 - environment and ecology
 - Agricultural economics
 - International trade
 - Development economics
 - Public economics 
 - Machine Learning Application
